newsitem.title: JAPAN: GOLF-BRITAIN'S WESTWOOD WINS TAIHEIYO MASTERS.
newsitem.headline: GOLF-BRITAIN'S WESTWOOD WINS TAIHEIYO MASTERS.

text.p: Briton Lee Westwood won Japan's Sumitomo Taiheiyo Masters tournament on Sunday, beating two rivals in a play-off after a contest reduced by fog.
Westwood, 23, defeated Jeff Sluman of the United States on the first hole of the sudden-death play-off. On the fourth, Italy's Constantino Rocca bogied while Westwood hit par.
Saturday's third round was cancelled due to fog at the Taiheiyo Club's Gotemba course, near Mount Fuji west of Tokyo.
It was Westwood's first tournament title in Japan. He finished sixth in the final European season rankings in the Volvo Masters at Vavlderrama, Spain, last month.
Westwood took home a prize of 20 million yen ($180,000).
